title: Fixed-coupon bond price from YTM on a coupon date
deliverables: per-bond table: price (per 100 or currency)
frame: DIKETAHUI: bonds [B]: coupon c (percent -> decimal), y (percent -> decimal), maturity T years, freq f, face F; valuation on a coupon date. DITANYAKAN: price per bond [B] in price-per-100 and/or currency. RUMUS: card Core 1; toolkit bond_price(ytm, coupon_rate, maturity, freq, face). n = round(T f) periods, CF_k = F c/f, last adds F. JAWAB: 1) n = T f, t_k = k/f [n]. 2) CF_k [n]. 3) P = sum CF_k (1+y/f)^(-k). 4) scale to face/notional. 5) check: c = y gives par, price falls when y rises.
pitfalls: percent coupon/yield not divided by 100
n from list index instead of T*f

title: Bond price from a discount curve (zero rates or DFs)
deliverables: per-bond table: price, per-cash-flow PV table [B x n]
frame: DIKETAHUI: bonds [B] (c, T, f, F); zero curve [P] (tenor, z or DF; compounding stated). DITANYAKAN: price per bond [B]; optional PV of each cash flow. RUMUS: card Core 1 curve form: P = sum CF_k DF(t_k); DF from toolkit discount_factor(z, t, compounding); interpolate z or ln DF between pillars. JAWAB: 1) cash-flow times t_k [n_b]. 2) z(t_k) by stated interpolation (flat beyond ends). 3) DF_k. 4) PV_k = CF_k DF_k. 5) P = sum PV_k. 6) optional: solve YTM from P (bond_ytm).
formulas: DF = exp(-z t) continuous; (1+z/f)^(-f t) periodic
pitfalls: zero compounding confused (annual vs continuous)

title: Dirty, clean and accrued between coupon dates (street convention)
deliverables: per-bond table: dirty, accrued, clean
frame: DIKETAHUI: bonds [B]: c, y, f, F, settlement date, coupon schedule (or maturity date); day count (ACT/ACT ICMA default). DITANYAKAN: dirty, accrued interest, clean price per bond [B] (per 100). RUMUS: card Core 1 (exponent w+k-1, w = days settle->next coupon / days in period), Core 2 (AI = (c/f) F (accrued days / period days)). JAWAB: 1) previous/next coupon dates. 2) w = DSC/E. 3) dirty = sum CF_k (1+y/f)^-(w+k-1). 4) AI = (c/f) F (1-w). 5) clean = dirty - AI. 6) check dirty = clean + AI, AI = 0 on coupon date.
pitfalls: accrued at coupon date set to full coupon instead of zero

title: Accrued interest for US corporate (30/360)
deliverables: per-trade table: accrual days, accrued interest (currency)
frame: DIKETAHUI: trades [M]: face, coupon c, f, last coupon date, settlement date; 30/360 US. DITANYAKAN: accrued days (30/360) and accrued interest per trade [M] in currency; dirty = clean + AI. RUMUS: card Core 2: AI = c F yf_30/360(last coupon, settle); day-count rules per 30/360 US (D1=min(d1,30); D2=30 if D1=30 and d2=31). JAWAB: 1) adjust D1, D2. 2) days = 360(Y2-Y1)+30(M2-M1)+(D2-D1). 3) AI = F c days/360. 4) invoice = (clean/100) F + AI. 5) check AI < F c/f.
pitfalls: ACT days used for a 30/360 bond

title: YTM from clean market price
deliverables: per-bond table: ytm (percent or decimal), dirty price
frame: DIKETAHUI: bonds [B]: clean price, c, f, F, settlement and coupon dates (or T on coupon date). DITANYAKAN: YTM per bond [B], compounding = coupon frequency, in stated unit. RUMUS: card Core 3: solve price(y) = dirty with brentq; toolkit bond_ytm(price, coupon_rate, maturity, freq, face) on coupon dates. JAWAB: 1) AI from schedule. 2) dirty = clean + AI. 3) brentq on f(y) = model_dirty(y) - dirty over a wide bracket. 4) convert unit (decimal -> percent if asked). 5) check: reprice, y > c iff price < par.
formulas: find y: sum CF_k (1+y/f)^-(w+k-1) = clean + AI
pitfalls: solving against clean instead of dirty
annual compounding for semi-annual bond

title: Continuously compounded yield and duration
deliverables: per-bond table: y_cont, duration, convexity
frame: DIKETAHUI: bonds [B]: price (or y), c, f, T; yield compounding stated continuous. DITANYAKAN: continuous yield, D (Macaulay = modified), convexity per bond [B]. RUMUS: card Core 4 (continuous: D_mod = D_mac), Core 5 continuous C = sum t^2 PV/P; Hull ch.4. JAWAB: 1) solve y: sum CF_k exp(-y t_k) = P. 2) PV_k = CF_k exp(-y t_k). 3) D = sum t_k PV_k / P. 4) C = sum t_k^2 PV_k / P. 5) dP ~ -D P dy + 0.5 C P dy^2.
pitfalls: dividing by (1+y/f) for a continuous yield

title: Zero-coupon bond price, yield, duration, convexity
deliverables: per-bond table: price, yield, D_mac, D_mod, convexity
frame: DIKETAHUI: zeros [B]: face, T, and yield y (freq f, or continuous) or price. DITANYAKAN: price or yield, D_mac, D_mod, convexity per zero [B]. RUMUS: card Core 1, 4, 5; Completing: convexity of a zero = T(T+1/f)/(1+y/f)^2 periodic, T^2 continuous. JAWAB: 1) P = F (1+y/f)^(-f T) or y from P. 2) D_mac = T. 3) D_mod = T/(1+y/f). 4) C = T(T+1/f)/(1+y/f)^2. 5) check D_mac = T exactly.

title: Macaulay and modified duration table for coupon bonds
deliverables: per-bond table: price, macaulay_duration, modified_duration (years)
frame: DIKETAHUI: bonds [B]: c, y, T, f, F (on coupon date unless settlement given). DITANYAKAN: D_mac and D_mod per bond [B] in years. RUMUS: card Core 4; toolkit duration_convexity(ytm, coupon_rate, maturity, freq, face) -> dict. JAWAB: 1) cash flows and t_k (years). 2) PV_k at y/f. 3) P = sum PV_k. 4) D_mac = sum t_k PV_k / P. 5) D_mod = D_mac/(1+y/f). 6) check D_mod < D_mac <= T.
pitfalls: D_mod = D_mac/(1+y) for semi-annual yield

title: Closed-form Macaulay duration and perpetuity/annuity durations
deliverables: per-instrument table: D_mac, D_mod
frame: DIKETAHUI: instruments [M]: type (perpetuity, annuity, coupon bond), periodic yield i = y/f, n periods, coupon per period c/f. DITANYAKAN: Macaulay duration (years) per instrument [M] via closed form, cross-checked against the sum. RUMUS: Fabozzi closed forms in periods, divide by f for years. JAWAB: 1) i = y/f. 2) perpetuity: D = (1+i)/i. 3) coupon bond: D = (1+i)/i - (1+i+n(c'-i))/(c'[(1+i)^n-1]+i), c' = c/f. 4) years = periods/f. 5) cross-check with direct sum.
pitfalls: forgetting to divide by f to get years

title: Convexity of coupon bonds (periodic yield)
deliverables: per-bond table: convexity (years^2), dollar convexity
frame: DIKETAHUI: bonds [B]: c, y, T, f, F. DITANYAKAN: convexity per bond [B] (C = (1/P) d2P/dy2); dollar convexity C P if asked. RUMUS: card Core 5: C = sum CF_k t_k(t_k+1/f)(1+y/f)^(-f t_k) / (P (1+y/f)^2); V4 default (a). JAWAB: 1) t_k, CF_k. 2) PV_k. 3) numerator sum CF_k t_k (t_k + 1/f) (1+y/f)^(-f t_k). 4) divide by P (1+y/f)^2. 5) check vs finite difference (P_up + P_dn - 2P)/(P h^2).
pitfalls: convexity in periods^2 not divided by f^2

title: Dealer convexity quoting and half-convexity scaling
deliverables: per-bond table: convexity raw, convexity quoted
frame: DIKETAHUI: bonds [B]: c, y, T, f; stated quoting convention for convexity. DITANYAKAN: convexity per bond [B] in the stated scaling (raw, /100, or 0.5 C). RUMUS: card V4: (a) C = (1/P) d2P/dy2 default; (b) dealer C/100 or half-convexity. JAWAB: 1) compute raw C (Core 5 or finite difference). 2) apply scaling exactly as stated. 3) price change uses matching form: dP/P = -D dy + 0.5 C dy^2 (raw) or + C_q (dy in percent)^2 when quoted. 4) state scaling in output.
pitfalls: mixing a /100 quote with the raw Taylor formula

title: Price change by duration-convexity approximation vs full repricing
deliverables: per-bond per-shock table: dP_dur, dP_dur_conv, dP_exact, error
frame: DIKETAHUI: bonds [B]; yield shocks [S] in bp. DITANYAKAN: approximated and exact price change per bond and shock [B x S] (percent and currency). RUMUS: card Core 8: dP/P ~ -D_mod dy + 0.5 C dy^2; exact = P(y+dy) - P(y) via bond_price. JAWAB: 1) dy = bp/1e4. 2) D_mod, C (duration_convexity). 3) dP_1 = -D_mod P dy. 4) dP_2 = dP_1 + 0.5 C P dy^2. 5) exact reprice. 6) errors; check error of 2nd-order << 1st-order, convexity term > 0.
pitfalls: bp not converted to decimal

title: DV01 / PV01 per bond and per notional
triggers: dollar value of a basis point
price value of a basis point
deliverables: per-bond table: dv01 (currency per bp), dollar duration
frame: DIKETAHUI: positions [B]: c, y, T, f, notional (face held), price (or y). DITANYAKAN: DV01 per position [B] in currency per 1bp, positive for a long bond. RUMUS: card Core 7: DV01 = D_mod P_dirty 1e-4; price per 100 -> times notional/100; or -(P_up - P_dn)/2 per 1bp bump. JAWAB: 1) dirty price per 100. 2) D_mod. 3) DV01_per100 = D_mod P 1e-4. 4) DV01 = DV01_per100 notional/100. 5) cross-check with central bump. 6) sum for portfolio.
pitfalls: DV01 on clean price
sign negative for a long bond

title: Effective duration and convexity by yield bumps
deliverables: per-bond table: P_up, P_down, D_eff, C_eff
frame: DIKETAHUI: bonds [B] (or pricing function); bump size h (default 1bp). DITANYAKAN: effective duration and convexity per bond [B]. RUMUS: card Core 6: D_eff = (P_dn - P_up)/(2 P h); C_eff = (P_up + P_dn - 2P)/(P h^2); V5 central default. JAWAB: 1) base P. 2) reprice at y+h and y-h (or curve +-h). 3) D_eff, C_eff. 4) one-sided if task says '+1bp only': -(P_up-P)/(P h). 5) check D_eff ~ D_mod for option-free bonds.
pitfalls: h too small with rounded prices (noise in C_eff)

title: Effective duration with par curve bump and re-bootstrap
deliverables: per-bond table: P_base, P_up, P_down, D_eff
frame: DIKETAHUI: par yields [P] (tenor, rate, freq); bonds [B]; bump h. DITANYAKAN: effective duration per bond [B] under a parallel par-yield shift. RUMUS: card Core 6 note: bump the curve actually used; toolkit bootstrap_par(maturities, par_rates, freq) -> DFs; price P = sum CF DF. JAWAB: 1) base DFs from par yields. 2) par +- h -> re-bootstrap DFs. 3) price each bond on base/up/down curves. 4) D_eff = (P_dn - P_up)/(2 P h). 5) note difference from zero-rate bump.
pitfalls: bumping zero rates when par yields are the stated risk factor

title: Key rate durations with tent (triangular) bumps
deliverables: KRD matrix [B x P]; check column: row sum vs effective duration
frame: DIKETAHUI: bonds [B]; zero curve [P] at key tenors; bump h (1bp). DITANYAKAN: KRD_k per bond and key [B x P] (years); sum_k KRD_k. RUMUS: card Core 9: KRD_k = -(P_up,k - P_dn,k)/(2 P h); tent shape 1 at key k, linear to 0 at k-1 and k+1, flat beyond ends. JAWAB: 1) for each key k build bump vector over pillars (or over cash-flow times via np.interp). 2) reprice +- h. 3) KRD_k. 4) row sum = D_eff of parallel shift. 5) dollar KRD = KRD P 1e-4 if asked.
pitfalls: bumping only pillar k when tent is the default (sum breaks)

title: Key rate durations with point (single-pillar) bumps
deliverables: KRD matrix [B x P]
frame: DIKETAHUI: bonds [B]; zero curve [P]; stated point bump of one pillar zero, interpolation rule between pillars. DITANYAKAN: KRD per pillar [B x P] under a point bump. RUMUS: card Core 9 'point bump only when stated': shift pillar k only; off-pillar cash flows feel it through interpolation (or zero if task says nearest-pillar). JAWAB: 1) curve with z_k + h. 2) interpolate DFs at cash flow times using the stated rule. 3) reprice. 4) KRD_k. 5) sum vs D_eff (equals it only for linear interpolation in z).

title: Partial DV01 / bucketed dollar KRDs, one-sided bump
deliverables: per-position x key table [B x P] in currency per bp
frame: DIKETAHUI: positions [B] with notionals; curve [P]; instruction 'bump each key rate up by +1bp'. DITANYAKAN: partial DV01 per position and key [B x P] in currency; totals per key [P]. RUMUS: card V5 (b) one-sided: PDV01_k = -(P_up,k - P) notional/100; dollar KRDs are additive across positions. JAWAB: 1) base price per 100. 2) bump key k up 1bp (tent). 3) PDV01 = (P - P_up,k) notional/100. 4) sum across positions per key. 5) total ~ portfolio DV01.

title: Portfolio duration, convexity and DV01 aggregation
deliverables: summary json: portfolio market value, duration, convexity, dv01
frame: DIKETAHUI: holdings [B]: face, c, y, T, f (or dirty price). DITANYAKAN: portfolio market value, value-weighted duration and convexity, total DV01. RUMUS: D_p = sum w_i D_i, w_i = MV_i / sum MV (dirty); DV01_p = sum DV01_i; C_p = sum w_i C_i. JAWAB: 1) MV_i = dirty_i face_i/100. 2) D_i, C_i, DV01_i. 3) weights w_i. 4) D_p, C_p. 5) DV01_p, check DV01_p = D_p MV_p 1e-4.
pitfalls: equal-weight average of durations

title: Portfolio key rate durations and dollar KRD aggregation
deliverables: per-key table [P]: portfolio KRD, dollar KRD
frame: DIKETAHUI: holdings [B]: units x_i, prices P_i, KRD matrix [B x P] (or inputs to compute it). DITANYAKAN: portfolio KRD [P] (years) and dollar KRD [P] (currency per bp). RUMUS: card Core 13: dollar KRDs additive; portfolio KRD_k = sum x_i P_i KRD_i,k / sum x_i P_i. JAWAB: 1) MV_i = x_i P_i. 2) dollar KRD_i,k = MV_i KRD_i,k 1e-4. 3) sum over i per key. 4) portfolio KRD = sum dollar / (MV_p 1e-4). 5) check sum_k = portfolio D_eff.
pitfalls: adding percent KRDs without value weights

title: DV01-neutral hedge with a single hedge bond
deliverables: summary json: hedge notional, residual dv01
frame: DIKETAHUI: target position (notional, bond terms) and hedge bond terms. DITANYAKAN: hedge face amount (currency) and sign; residual DV01 after hedge. RUMUS: N_h = -DV01_target / DV01_hedge_per_unit (Tuckman ch.6). JAWAB: 1) DV01 of target in currency. 2) DV01 of hedge per 1 face (per100 / 100). 3) N_h = -DV01_T / dv01_h. 4) residual = DV01_T + N_h dv01_h = 0. 5) report sign (short = negative).
pitfalls: per-100 vs per-unit DV01 mismatch

title: Duration-based hedge with bond/interest-rate futures
deliverables: summary json: number of contracts (rounded and unrounded)
frame: DIKETAHUI: portfolio value V_P and duration D_P; futures price F and contract size, D_F of underlying (CTD), conversion factor CF if DV01-based. DITANYAKAN: number of futures contracts to short (and rounding). RUMUS: Hull ch.6: N* = V_P D_P / (V_F D_F); DV01 form: N = DV01_P / (DV01_CTD / CF). JAWAB: 1) V_F = futures quote x contract size/100. 2) D_F of CTD at delivery. 3) N* = V_P D_P/(V_F D_F). 4) to target duration D*: N = (D* - D_P) V_P/(V_F D_F). 5) round as instructed.

title: Two-bond Redington immunization
deliverables: summary json: weights, units, PV and duration residuals, convexity check
frame: DIKETAHUI: liability flows (or PV_L, D_L, C_L); two bonds (c, T, f) priced off yield or curve. DITANYAKAN: value weights w1,w2, amounts (currency) and units per bond; convexity condition C_A >= C_L. RUMUS: card Core 13: w1 + w2 = 1, w1 D1 + w2 D2 = D_L; units = w_i PV_L / dirty_i. JAWAB: 1) PV_L, D_L, C_L (same curve/yield). 2) D_i, C_i, P_i. 3) w1 = (D_L - D2)/(D1 - D2). 4) amounts w_i PV_L, units. 5) check PV, dollar duration match; C_A >= C_L; parallel-shift P&L small.
formulas: PV_A = PV_L, D_A PV_A = D_L PV_L
pitfalls: duration of liability on different curve than assets

title: Redington conditions check for an existing portfolio
deliverables: summary json: PV_A, PV_L, D_A, D_L, C_A, C_L, flags; table of surplus under shifts
frame: DIKETAHUI: asset holdings [B], liability flows [L]; yield or curve; shift grid [S]. DITANYAKAN: Redington condition flags and surplus change per shift [S]. RUMUS: card Core 13: surplus S = PV_A - PV_L; dS/dy = 0 needs dollar durations equal; d2S/dy2 > 0 needs C_A PV_A > C_L PV_L. JAWAB: 1) PV, D, C for assets and liabilities. 2) duration gap D_A - D_L PV_L/PV_A. 3) flags. 4) reprice both under each shift. 5) check surplus >= 0 near 0 if conditions hold.
formulas: dollar gap = D_A PV_A - D_L PV_L

title: Three-bond immunization matching PV, duration and convexity
deliverables: summary json: weights [3], residuals
frame: DIKETAHUI: liability (PV_L, D_L, C_L) and 3 bonds with D_i, C_i, prices. DITANYAKAN: value weights [3] matching PV, duration and convexity; units. RUMUS: solve [1 1 1; D1 D2 D3; C1 C2 C3] w = [1, D_L, C_L]. JAWAB: 1) D_i, C_i, P_i. 2) assemble 3x3. 3) np.linalg.solve. 4) amounts w PV_L, units. 5) check residuals ~ 0; flag negative weights (shorts) if long-only required.

title: KRD-matching immunization (multi-key hedge)
deliverables: summary json: units [B], residual dollar KRD per key [P]
frame: DIKETAHUI: liability flows; hedge bonds [B]; key tenors [P]; KRD matrix of bonds [B x P] and liability [P]. DITANYAKAN: units x [B] such that dollar KRDs match per key; residuals [P]. RUMUS: card Core 13: sum_i x_i P_i KRD_i,k = PV_L KRD_L,k for each k; B = P exact solve, B > P min-norm / objective, B < P least squares. JAWAB: 1) KRD bonds and liability (tent bumps, same curve). 2) A_ki = P_i KRD_i,k; b_k = PV_L KRD_L,k. 3) solve (lstsq / constraints). 4) add PV constraint if stated. 5) check residuals, scale by PV_L.
formulas: sum_i x_i P_i KRD_i,k = PV_L KRD_L,k for all k
pitfalls: mixing percent and dollar KRDs in the constraint

title: Cash-flow matching (dedication) by linear programming
deliverables: summary json: holdings [B], cost, surplus per date [T]
frame: DIKETAHUI: liabilities per date [T]; candidate bonds [B]: prices, cash-flow matrix [T x B]; reinvestment rate (often 0); long-only bounds. DITANYAKAN: holdings x [B] minimising cost such that cumulative inflows cover liabilities each date; surplus [T]. RUMUS: min p'x s.t. CF x + (1+r) s_{t-1} - s_t = L_t, x >= 0, s >= 0 (scipy linprog). JAWAB: 1) cash-flow matrix CF [T x B] on a common date grid. 2) variables x and surplus s. 3) equality constraints per date. 4) linprog(method='highs'). 5) check coverage, cost <= duration-matched cost? report both.

title: Liability PV and duration from a zero curve
deliverables: summary json: PV_L, D_L, C_L, DV01_L
frame: DIKETAHUI: liability flows [L] (time, amount); zero curve [P] with compounding. DITANYAKAN: PV, curve duration, convexity, DV01 of liabilities. RUMUS: card Completing: liability = zero-coupon flows on the same curve; Fisher-Weil D = sum t PV_t / PV with continuous zeros. JAWAB: 1) interpolate z(t) at flow times. 2) DF, PV_t. 3) PV_L = sum PV_t. 4) D = sum t PV_t / PV_L (continuous), C = sum t^2 PV_t / PV_L. 5) DV01 = D PV_L 1e-4.
formulas: D_FW = sum t L_t DF(t) / PV_L

title: Horizon return and immunization at the Macaulay duration
deliverables: per-scenario table: horizon value, realized annualized return
frame: DIKETAHUI: bond (c, y, T, f); horizon H; rate shocks [S] applied immediately (reinvestment at shocked yield). DITANYAKAN: horizon value and realized return per shock [S]; show H = D_mac near-immunizes. RUMUS: Fabozzi total return: FV_H = coupons reinvested at y' to H + price at H at y'. JAWAB: 1) for each shock y' = y + dy. 2) future value of coupons to H at y'/f. 3) price at H of remaining flows at y'. 4) total return (FV_H/P0)^(1/(f H)) - 1, annualized x f. 5) compare across shocks; minimal spread when H = D_mac.

title: Z-spread over a zero curve
deliverables: per-bond table: z_spread (bp)
frame: DIKETAHUI: bonds [B]: dirty price, cash flows; zero curve [P] (continuous). DITANYAKAN: z-spread per bond [B] in bp. RUMUS: card Core 10: sum CF_k exp(-(z(t_k)+s) t_k) = P_dirty; brentq on s. JAWAB: 1) cash flows and z(t_k). 2) f(s) = sum CF exp(-(z+s)t) - P. 3) brentq bracket e.g. [-0.05, 0.5]. 4) s in bp = 1e4 s. 5) check s ~ 0 for a bond priced off the same curve.
pitfalls: using clean price
periodic compounding on continuous zeros

title: Yield spreads: G-spread and I-spread vs interpolated benchmark
deliverables: per-bond table: ytm, benchmark yield, spread (bp)
frame: DIKETAHUI: bonds [B] with YTM (or price) and maturity; benchmark curve [P] (govt yields or swap rates). DITANYAKAN: benchmark yield at bond maturity and spread per bond [B] in bp. RUMUS: spread = YTM_bond - y_bench(T) with linear interpolation in maturity (flat beyond ends). JAWAB: 1) YTM per bond (bond_ytm). 2) np.interp(T, bench tenors, bench yields). 3) spread = (ytm - bench) 1e4. 4) note compounding consistency. 5) rank rich/cheap.

title: FRN dirty price between reset dates
deliverables: per-FRN table: dirty, accrued, clean, effective duration
frame: DIKETAHUI: FRNs [B]: notional N, last fixing rate, accrual dates, time to next reset t_next; discount curve; zero spread. DITANYAKAN: dirty, accrued, clean price and effective duration per FRN [B]. RUMUS: card Core 11: dirty = (N + known coupon) DF(t_next); D_eff ~ t_next. JAWAB: 1) known coupon = N r_fix tau (period day count). 2) DF(t_next). 3) dirty = (N + C) DF. 4) AI = N r_fix tau_accrued; clean = dirty - AI. 5) D_eff by bump ~ t_next, not maturity.
pitfalls: FRN duration reported as maturity

title: FRN with quoted margin and discount margin
deliverables: per-FRN table: price, discount margin (bp)
frame: DIKETAHUI: FRN: quoted margin q, reset schedule [n], forward index rates (projection curve), discount curve; market price (for DM). DITANYAKAN: price given DM, or DM solving price; spread duration. RUMUS: coupon_j = (F_j + q) tau_j N; P = sum coupon_j DF_j(dm) + N DF_n(dm), DF with index + dm. JAWAB: 1) projected F_j from projection curve. 2) cash flows with q. 3) discount at curve shifted by dm (or (1+(F_j+dm)tau) chain). 4) brentq on dm vs market price. 5) q = dm => par at reset date.

title: Callable bond with deterministic call: price and yield-to-worst
deliverables: per-bond table: non-call price, callable price, ytc, ytm, ytw
frame: DIKETAHUI: callable bonds [B]: c, f, T, call date t_c, call price K_c; yield or curve; market price for yields. DITANYAKAN: callable price, yield to call, yield to worst per bond [B]. RUMUS: card Core 12: P = min(P_noncall, PV(flows to t_c) + K_c DF(t_c)); YTW = min(YTM, YTC_j). JAWAB: 1) P_noncall. 2) P_to_call. 3) P_callable = min. 4) YTC: solve flows to call + K_c = P (brentq). 5) YTW = min over call dates and maturity. 6) check P_call <= P_noncall, call binds when c > y.
formulas: P_call = min(P_nc, sum_{t_k<=t_c} CF_k DF_k + K_c DF(t_c))

title: Callable bond effective duration and negative convexity
deliverables: per-bond table: D_eff, C_eff for callable vs non-callable
frame: DIKETAHUI: callable bonds [B] with pricing rule (deterministic call or tree); bump h. DITANYAKAN: effective duration and convexity per bond [B], compared with non-callable. RUMUS: card Core 6 applied to the callable price function; V3 (b) effective for embedded options. JAWAB: 1) price callable at y, y+h, y-h (or curve shifts). 2) D_eff, C_eff. 3) same for straight bond. 4) check D_call <= D_nc when call binds; C_eff can be < 0. 5) report.
pitfalls: using modified duration formula for a callable

title: PCA of yield curve changes: eigenvalues and explained variance
deliverables: per-PC table [k]: eigenvalue, explained ratio, cumulative; loadings [k x P]
frame: DIKETAHUI: yield history [T x P] (dates x tenors), units percent or bp. DITANYAKAN: top-k eigenvalues, explained variance ratios, cumulative, loadings [k x P]. RUMUS: card Core 14: X = diff(levels) [T-1 x P]; Sigma = cov(X, ddof=1); eigh; sort descending; ratio = lambda/sum(all lambda); V6 (a). JAWAB: 1) sort by date, diff -> changes. 2) covariance ddof=1 (units as asked). 3) np.linalg.eigh, sort desc. 4) ratios over ALL eigenvalues; cumulative. 5) sign conventions (PC1 sum>0, PC2 long-short>0). 6) check unit norms, positivity.
pitfalls: PCA on levels
dividing by top-3 sum

title: PCA loadings sign convention and level/slope/curvature labeling
deliverables: loadings table [3 x P] with signs fixed
frame: DIKETAHUI: loadings from eigh [P x P] for yield changes; tenors [P]. DITANYAKAN: three loadings with deterministic signs and labels. RUMUS: card Conventions: PC1 loadings sum > 0; PC2 (long - short) > 0; PC3 belly < wings (or stated rule). JAWAB: 1) sort eigenpairs desc. 2) flip PC1 if sum < 0. 3) flip PC2 if v[-1] - v[0] < 0. 4) flip PC3 if belly loading > mean of wings. 5) unit norm check; label.

title: Factor exposures of a portfolio to PCA factors via KRDs
deliverables: per-position x factor table [B x k]
frame: DIKETAHUI: KRD matrix [B x P] (or dollar KRDs), PCA loadings [k x P] on the same key tenors and units. DITANYAKAN: exposure of each position to each PC [B x k]; portfolio total. RUMUS: card Core 14: exposure_ik = sum_p KRD_i,p loading_k,p (dollar version uses dollar KRDs; loading units = rate change per unit factor). JAWAB: 1) align tenors of KRD and loadings. 2) E = KRD @ L.T. 3) dollar exposure: P&L per unit factor = -$KRD @ L.T x 1e4 if loadings in decimal. 4) sum over positions. 5) check units.

title: PCA factor hedge: neutralize level and slope with two hedges
deliverables: summary json: hedge notionals [2], residual factor exposures
frame: DIKETAHUI: portfolio dollar KRD [P]; hedge instruments [H=2] dollar KRDs [H x P]; loadings [2 x P]. DITANYAKAN: hedge notionals neutralizing PC1 and PC2 exposures; residual exposures. RUMUS: exposures e_port = L $KRD_port; e_h = L $KRD_h; solve e_h^T n = -e_port. JAWAB: 1) factor exposures of portfolio and each hedge. 2) 2x2 system. 3) solve n. 4) residual on PC1, PC2 = 0; report PC3 residual. 5) variance of residual P&L using eigenvalues if asked.

title: PCA input variants: correlation vs covariance, bp vs percent
deliverables: per-PC table: eigenvalue in stated units, explained ratio
frame: DIKETAHUI: yield history [T x P]; instruction on PCA input (covariance or correlation) and units. DITANYAKAN: eigenvalues and explained ratios under the stated input. RUMUS: card V6: (a) covariance of changes default; (b) correlation; changes in bp scale eigenvalues by 1e4 vs percent (ratios unchanged). JAWAB: 1) changes. 2) scale to stated unit (percent x100 -> bp). 3) covariance (ddof=1) or correlation. 4) eigh, sort. 5) report ratios (scale-invariant for covariance), eigenvalues in unit^2.

title: Curve stress scenarios: parallel, steepener, butterfly, full repricing
deliverables: per-position x scenario P&L table [B x S]; portfolio totals [S]
frame: DIKETAHUI: positions [B]; zero curve [P]; scenarios [S] defined by bp shocks at anchor tenors. DITANYAKAN: P&L per position and scenario (currency); portfolio totals. RUMUS: card Completing: parallel constant; steepener linear in maturity between anchors; butterfly via key points with np.interp (flat beyond ends). JAWAB: 1) shock vector per scenario on pillar tenors (np.interp). 2) shocked zeros -> DFs. 3) reprice positions. 4) P&L = (P_s - P_0) notional/100. 5) sum. 6) check parallel P&L ~ -DV01 x shift.

title: Stress P&L by KRD approximation vs full repricing
deliverables: per-scenario table: pnl_krd, pnl_full, error
frame: DIKETAHUI: portfolio dollar KRDs [P] (or bonds to compute them); scenario shocks [S x P] in bp. DITANYAKAN: first-order P&L by KRD, full P&L, error per scenario. RUMUS: P&L_krd = -sum_k $KRD_k dz_k(bp) (with $KRD per bp); full = reprice. JAWAB: 1) $KRD per bp. 2) shock matrix in bp. 3) P&L_krd = -shock @ $KRD. 4) full repricing. 5) error = full - krd (convexity, positive for big parallel moves).

title: Par bond check and price-yield table
deliverables: price table [B x Y]
frame: DIKETAHUI: bond (c, T, f); yield grid [Y]. DITANYAKAN: price per yield [Y]; classification premium/par/discount. RUMUS: card Invariants: par bond (c = y on a coupon date) prices at 100; toolkit bond_price vectorized over y. JAWAB: 1) price for each y. 2) label: P > 100 premium (c > y), = par, < discount. 3) check monotone decreasing and convex in y. 4) write table.
formulas: P = 100 iff c = y on coupon date

title: Amortizing / sinking-fund bond cash flows and duration
deliverables: per-period cash-flow table [n]; summary: price, D_mac, WAL
frame: DIKETAHUI: bond with amortization schedule (principal per period) or level-payment annuity; c, f, y. DITANYAKAN: cash flows, price, Macaulay duration, weighted average life. RUMUS: CF_k = interest on outstanding + principal_k; WAL = sum t_k principal_k / sum principal. JAWAB: 1) outstanding balance path. 2) interest_k = B_{k-1} c/f. 3) CF_k. 4) price, D_mac, D_mod. 5) WAL (principal only). 6) check sum principal = face.
formulas: WAL = sum t_k A_k / sum A_k

title: Bond with odd (short or long) first coupon
deliverables: per-bond table: first coupon amount, dirty, clean
frame: DIKETAHUI: bond: issue (dated) date, first coupon date, regular schedule, c, f, y; settlement date. DITANYAKAN: first coupon amount, dirty and clean price. RUMUS: ICMA: stub coupon = (c/f) F (stub days / regular period days); long stub sums notional sub-periods; price with fractional exponent w. JAWAB: 1) quasi-coupon dates. 2) stub coupon amount. 3) w at settlement. 4) dirty = sum CF (1+y/f)^-(w+k-1). 5) AI from dated date. 6) clean.

title: Ex-dividend period and negative accrued interest (gilts)
deliverables: per-trade table: accrued (possibly negative), dirty, clean
frame: DIKETAHUI: bonds [B]: coupon schedule, ex-div date (e.g. business days before coupon), settlement, c, f, y. DITANYAKAN: accrued interest and dirty/clean price; whether buyer receives next coupon. RUMUS: settle in ex-div period: next coupon excluded from dirty, AI = -(c/f) F (days settle->coupon / period days). JAWAB: 1) next coupon and ex date. 2) if settle >= ex: drop next coupon from flows; AI negative. 3) dirty from remaining flows. 4) clean = dirty - AI. 5) check continuity of clean price.

title: Carry and roll-down over a horizon
deliverables: per-bond table: carry, roll-down, total (bp or currency)
frame: DIKETAHUI: bonds [B]; zero curve [P]; horizon h; repo/funding rate (optional). DITANYAKAN: carry (coupon - funding), roll-down (price change from aging on an unchanged curve), total. RUMUS: rolldown = P(T-h on same z curve) - P(T); carry = coupon accrual - repo x dirty x h. JAWAB: 1) price today. 2) shift cash-flow times by -h, reprice on the same curve. 3) roll = difference. 4) carry from coupons and financing. 5) total; compare with forward-implied (zero under realized forwards).
formulas: Carry = c F h - r_repo P_dirty h

title: Fisher-Weil (curve) duration vs yield Macaulay duration
deliverables: per-bond table: D_mac(yield), D_fw(curve)
frame: DIKETAHUI: bonds [B]; zero curve [P] (continuous); YTM. DITANYAKAN: Fisher-Weil duration (curve PVs) and yield-based Macaulay per bond. RUMUS: card Core 4 curve variant: PV_k = CF_k DF(t_k); D_FW = sum t_k PV_k / P; equals -dlnP/ds for parallel continuous shift. JAWAB: 1) PV with DF. 2) D_FW. 3) YTM from price, D_mac at y. 4) compare (equal for flat curve). 5) check with bump of all zeros.
formulas: D_FW = sum t_k CF_k DF(t_k) / P

title: Spread duration of a credit bond
deliverables: per-bond table: spread duration, CS01 (currency per bp)
frame: DIKETAHUI: bonds [B]: price, cash flows; zero curve; z-spread s. DITANYAKAN: spread duration and CS01 per bond. RUMUS: D_s = (P(s-h) - P(s+h))/(2 P h) holding the base curve; CS01 = D_s P 1e-4 x notional/100. JAWAB: 1) solve s (Core 10). 2) reprice at s +- h. 3) D_s. 4) CS01. 5) check D_s ~ D_eff for fixed-rate bonds, ~ maturity-like for FRNs.

title: Rich/cheap analysis: model vs market price off a fitted curve
deliverables: per-bond table: model price, market price, price residual, yield residual (bp)
frame: DIKETAHUI: bonds [B] with market clean prices; fitted/bootstrapped curve. DITANYAKAN: model dirty/clean price, residual and yield residual per bond; rich/cheap label. RUMUS: model P = sum CF DF; yield residual = YTM(market) - YTM(model) or residual / DV01. JAWAB: 1) model dirty from curve. 2) market dirty = clean + AI. 3) residual = market - model. 4) yield residual ~ -residual/(D_mod P) x 1e4. 5) cheap if market < model (positive yield residual).

title: Barbell vs bullet with equal duration
deliverables: summary table: duration, convexity, P&L per scenario for barbell and bullet
frame: DIKETAHUI: short, long and intermediate bonds; target duration; scenarios. DITANYAKAN: barbell weights matching bullet duration; convexity comparison; scenario P&L. RUMUS: w_s D_s + (1-w_s) D_l = D_b; convexity barbell > bullet; dollar duration matched. JAWAB: 1) D, C of all bonds. 2) weights. 3) convexities. 4) parallel and twist scenarios P&L. 5) report.

title: Immunization with weight bounds by optimisation (more bonds than constraints)
deliverables: summary json: weights [B], constraint residuals, objective
frame: DIKETAHUI: liability (PV_L, D_L, C_L or KRDs); candidate bonds [B]; bounds (e.g. 0 <= w <= w_max); objective (min-norm, max convexity, min cost). DITANYAKAN: weights [B] satisfying constraints and objective; residuals. RUMUS: card Conventions: many solutions -> stated objective; enforce bounds; scale constraints by PV_L; check residuals. JAWAB: 1) build constraint matrix (sum w = 1, w'D = D_L, ...). 2) scipy minimize SLSQP with bounds or lstsq min-norm. 3) residuals. 4) amounts/units. 5) report convexity and parallel-shift hedge error.
formulas: s.t. sum w = 1, w'D = D_L, w'C >= C_L, lb <= w <= ub
pitfalls: trusting success flag instead of residuals

title: Immunized portfolio verification under parallel shifts
deliverables: per-shift table: PV_A, PV_L, surplus
frame: DIKETAHUI: asset units [B], liability flows; shifts [S] (bp). DITANYAKAN: PV of assets and liabilities and surplus per shift; max error. RUMUS: reprice both under y + dy (or z + dy); surplus(dy) = PV_A - PV_L; Redington implies surplus >= 0 small dy. JAWAB: 1) base PVs, check match. 2) loop shifts. 3) surplus. 4) relative error / PV_L. 5) flag failures beyond tolerance.

title: Rebalancing an immunized portfolio after time passes
deliverables: summary json: old vs new weights, required trades
frame: DIKETAHUI: initial immunized holdings; elapsed time dt; new curve/yields; remaining liability. DITANYAKAN: new weights solved fresh; trades (units to buy/sell). RUMUS: card Pitfalls: stale hedge - recompute D_i, D_L at new date and curve, then solve again. JAWAB: 1) shift times by dt, drop paid flows. 2) new PV, D of assets and liability. 3) solve weights (Core 13). 4) new units vs old -> trades. 5) residual checks.
pitfalls: reusing old weights

title: Bond total return decomposition (income, price, yield change)
deliverables: per-bond table: income, roll, duration effect, convexity effect, residual
frame: DIKETAHUI: bond holdings over a period: start/end yields, coupon, start price, durations. DITANYAKAN: return components per bond. RUMUS: R ~ y dt - D_mod dy + 0.5 C dy^2 + residual; exact = (P_end + coupons - P_start)/P_start. JAWAB: 1) exact return. 2) income = c/P dt or y dt. 3) duration term. 4) convexity term. 5) residual = exact - sum.
formulas: R ~ y dt - D_mod dy + 0.5 C dy^2

title: Price, duration table using dirty price convention default
deliverables: per-bond table: dirty, clean, D_mac, D_mod, DV01
frame: DIKETAHUI: bonds [B] settling between coupons; c, y, f; dates. DITANYAKAN: durations and DV01 based on dirty price; clean as quoted. RUMUS: card V1 default dirty: D_mac = sum t_k PV_k / P_dirty with t_k = (w + k - 1)/f. JAWAB: 1) w. 2) PV_k at fractional exponents. 3) dirty. 4) D_mac with fractional t_k. 5) D_mod, DV01 on dirty. 6) clean = dirty - AI.
pitfalls: clean price in denominator

title: Convexity via finite differences when formula is ambiguous
deliverables: per-bond table: C_analytic, C_fd, difference
frame: DIKETAHUI: bond pricing function (yield or curve), bump h. DITANYAKAN: convexity by finite differences, compared with analytic. RUMUS: card Completing: C_fd = (P_+ + P_- - 2P)/(P h^2); choose h ~ 1e-4 (stable for double precision). JAWAB: 1) P, P_+, P_-. 2) C_fd. 3) analytic (Core 5). 4) relative diff small. 5) report with convention.

title: Missing price: price off a bootstrapped curve then YTM and durations
deliverables: per-bond table: model price, ytm, D_mod, DV01
frame: DIKETAHUI: par yields [P] (no bond prices); bonds [B] terms. DITANYAKAN: model price, YTM and risk per bond. RUMUS: card Completing: price off the bootstrapped curve; toolkit bootstrap_par -> DFs, then bond_ytm, duration_convexity. JAWAB: 1) bootstrap DFs. 2) price bonds sum CF DF. 3) YTM by bond_ytm. 4) duration_convexity at YTM. 5) check par instruments reprice to par.

title: Treasury futures DV01 via cheapest-to-deliver and conversion factor
deliverables: summary json: futures DV01, hedge contracts
frame: DIKETAHUI: deliverable bonds [D]: prices, conversion factors CF; futures price F; contract size; portfolio DV01. DITANYAKAN: CTD, futures DV01, hedge ratio in contracts. RUMUS: CTD minimises P_clean - F CF (gross basis); DV01_fut ~ DV01_CTD / CF; N = DV01_port / DV01_fut. JAWAB: 1) basis per deliverable. 2) CTD = argmin. 3) DV01_CTD per contract face. 4) divide by CF. 5) N contracts; round.
